scripts.build: npm run build:bootstrap && npm run build:css && npm run build:jquery && npm run build:tinymce && npm run build:chartjs && npm run build:feather && npm run build:tablesort && npm run build:highlighttextarea
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p public/assets/css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map resources/scss/style.scss public/assets/css/style.min.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map resources/scss/style-email.scss public/assets/css/style-email.min.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map resources/scss/style-intro.scss public/assets/css/style-intro.min.css
scripts.build:bootstrap: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/bootstrap-4.6.2 && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/bootstrap-4.6.2/css public/assets/vendor/bootstrap-4.6.2/js && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map resources/scss/bootstrap-custom.scss public/assets/vendor/bootstrap-4.6.2/css/bootstrap.min.css && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js public/assets/vendor/bootstrap-4.6.2/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
scripts.build:jquery: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/jquery && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/jquery && cp node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js public/assets/vendor/jquery/
scripts.build:tinymce: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/tinymce && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/tinymce && cp -R node_modules/tinymce/. public/assets/vendor/tinymce/ && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/tinymce/langs && cp resources/tinymce/langs/cs.js public/assets/vendor/tinymce/langs/cs.js
scripts.build:chartjs: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/chartjs && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/chartjs && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js public/assets/vendor/chartjs/ && cp node_modules/chartjs-plugin-datalabels/dist/chartjs-plugin-datalabels.min.js public/assets/vendor/chartjs/
scripts.build:feather: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/feather && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/feather && cp node_modules/feather-icons/dist/feather.min.js public/assets/vendor/feather/
scripts.build:tablesort: rm -rf public/assets/vendor/table-sort-js && mkdir -p public/assets/vendor/table-sort-js && cp node_modules/table-sort-js/table-sort.js public/assets/vendor/table-sort-js/
